profile.headline: Junior Software Engineer
profile.summary: A Computer Science graduate with a burning passion for software engineering and a strong drive to bring innovative tech solutions to life.

positions.title: Junior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Participating in an intensive training program through Dev Academy focused on no-code and coding technologies, including Bubble, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. 

Working closely with experienced team members to build technical, problem-solving, and collaboration skills in preparation for contributing to real-world projects.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Worked with algorithms, data structures and core computer science concepts to improve workflow.
•	Used communication and teamwork skills to help contribute to the company’s goals.
•	Utilized software such as Splunk to help organize company’s data for them to work more efficiently.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Used Java, Python, HTML, Bootstrap, and Google Cloud SDK during the Google Computer Science Summer Institute, gaining a diverse skill set.

Collaborated in a team of three to design a website, contributing to both backend and frontend development, showcasing practical application of learned skills in a team-oriented setting.
positions.insights: Web Technologies, Back-End Web Development and +2 skills

company.name: Goodwill of Western and Northern Connecticut, Inc.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Computer Science with a Minor in Mathematics
